scope.title: Responsive & accessibility baseline
scope.purpose: Establish the measurable global baseline, route/component risk inventory, device matrix and ownership for W6-5 before responsive or accessibility fixes are made.

target.accessibility: WCAG 2.2 AA target; no compliance claim is made by this static baseline.
target.automatedBaseline: Existing Axe browser coverage uses wcag2a, wcag2aa and wcag21aa tags; W6-5 must expand route coverage and decide how WCAG 2.2 criteria are covered by automation plus manual QA.
target.touch: BetterMakati product baseline is at least 44px interaction height for primary and repeated touch controls; full-card links may satisfy the target through their padded clickable box.
target.reflow: No whole-page horizontal scrolling at 320 CSS px. Local horizontal scrolling is allowed for dense tables or intentional chip/tab strips when the surrounding page remains usable.
target.keyboard: All interactive functionality must remain keyboard reachable with visible focus and sensible focus return/order.
target.motion: Reduced-motion preference must suppress or reduce non-essential animation and auto-rotation.
target.semantics: Pages keep one primary main landmark, a usable skip link, accessible names for controls, and status/alert semantics for meaningful asynchronous state.

deviceMatrix.purpose: WCAG reflow floor and smallest practical responsive stress case
primary mobile interaction and touch-target pass
mid-breakpoint wrapping, navigation and form/table composition
tablet/compact laptop landscape and breakpoint transitions
desktop navigation, keyboard menus, dense data and focus order

globalPasses.evidence: App renders a Skip to main content link and one main#main-content landmark with tabIndex=-1.
Global focus-visible styling exists for links, buttons, inputs, selects, textareas and summaries.
brand buttons and shared form inputs/selects/textareas have a 44px minimum height.
Desktop navigation is deferred to xl and mobile navigation is used below xl, avoiding a compressed intermediate desktop menu.
Navbar submenu controls use aria-expanded/aria-controls, Escape closes menus and returns focus, and route changes close open navigation.
Site search uses combobox/listbox/option semantics with keyboard navigation and active-descendant state.
SectionNav wraps and uses 44px minimum-height internal anchors.
Civic area context map has a titled iframe and 44px layer toggles with aria-pressed.

findings.finding: Emergency, City Hall, Hotlines and official-site utility links do not consistently use the 44px product touch baseline.
findings.evidence: Top utility links have no explicit 44px minimum interaction height.

findings.finding: Footer navigation and ecosystem links use min-h-9 (36px), while contact/social/legal links have no shared minimum target.
findings.evidence: Footer contains min-h-9 and plain inline links.

findings.finding: The visible edition control and homepage action use min-h-10 (40px), below BetterMakati’s 44px product baseline.
findings.evidence: Context bar uses min-h-10 for both visible control surfaces.

findings.finding: Photo-selection dot buttons use h-9/w-9 (36px). Attribution/fallback source links are also compact inline targets.
Table/List toggle buttons do not expose aria-pressed, do not explicitly set type=button, and do not preserve the 44px product touch baseline.
findings.evidence: Toggle classes use px-3 py-2 without min-h-11; state is visual only.

findings.surface: tables, maps, carousels, timeline grids and dense filters
findings.finding: Static responsive classes are present, but current-main rendering at narrow widths cannot be proven without a current browser build.
findings.evidence: Vercel is build-rate limited, so production may not contain the latest main branch.

findings.finding: The Axe suite lists 28 routes while the router has 51 substantive public route patterns; several newer high-value domains have no representative Axe route.
Existing Axe tags explicitly cover WCAG 2.0 A/AA and 2.1 AA, not a documented WCAG 2.2 automated target.
findings.evidence: accessibility.spec.mjs uses wcag2a, wcag2aa and wcag21aa.

findings.finding: No current-main visual proof yet exists for the full W6-5 device matrix, keyboard-only navigation, zoom/reflow, or runtime contrast/layout behavior.
findings.evidence: Current Vercel deployments are blocked by the project/account build-rate limit.

bounded.reason: Vercel build-rate limiting prevents treating the live deployment as proof of the latest main branch.
Static class inspection cannot establish computed contrast for every component/state.
ARIA/source inspection and Axe cannot fully establish practical screen-reader announcements and reading order.
